source_of_truth: Read by hand in app/components/ExportTable.vue: (A) the computed getter builds a LOCAL object `row` and mutates its own fields before returning it, a pure derivation with no fetch/$fetch/emit/storage/DOM/router token in its body, so it is not a computed side effect; (B) xlsx appears only as `import type { WorkBook }` (type-only, erased at build) and `await import('xlsx')` inside an event handler (dynamic), so there is no static value import of xlsx; (C) the watch target is the getter `() => state.filter`, not the whole reactive object, so there is no implicit deep traversal. Every pattern is correct code; a correct auditor reports nothing.

forbidden.why_not_a_defect: the getter mutates a local object it just created and returns it; there is no I/O, navigation, emit or DOM access, which is a pure, idiomatic derivation.
xlsx is imported type-only (erased at build) and otherwise reached only via a dynamic await import() inside an event handler; no static value import ships it on load.
watch targets the specific getter () => state.filter, not the whole reactive object, so Vue does not deep-traverse.
